clinical_observations.content: Sabrina participated in an in-clinic evaluation with her mother present. Sabrina exhibited a generally cheerful and compliant affect; however, her attention span was inconsistent, with notable periods of distractibility. Muscle tone was within normal limits, and range of motion assessments were unremarkable. Her engagement varied, particularly during tasks requiring sustained focus, necessitating frequent verbal and visual redirection. In structured activities, Sabrina demonstrated enhanced performance but showed diminished initiation in self-directed scenarios. Fine motor coordination was developing, as evident by challenges in tasks that necessitated hand-over-hand assistance for successful completion. Behavioral observations included restlessness and periodic reluctance, which, when coupled with her distractibility, necessitated testing modifications to ensure the validity of standardized measures. Overall, Sabrina's performance required significant support to gauge her abilities accurately.
